summary: The policy bounds the emitted diff but not the full blobs it mandates fetching, leaving broker acquisition vulnerable to oversized-file resource exhaustion before the diff limit can be applied.

findings.impact: The broker must acquire complete base/head blobs, while maxRawDiffBytes only bounds the reconstructed diff. A changed oversized blob can force unbounded download, decoding, hashing, and memory/disk use before the 80 KB diff limit rejects it.
findings.fix: Add a fail-closed maximum decoded blob size and bounded streaming/response limits enforced before full buffering or hashing; constrain baseBytes/headBytes accordingly in the runtime schema and add regression cases rejecting oversized file records/acquisition.
